title: Minimal ray query occlusion in volume.frag (gated)
rationale: Introduce a boolean RT shadow term with strict gating to validate the full RT path without heavy cost.

edits.action: Add #extension GL_EXT_ray_query : require and layout(binding=3) uniform accelerationStructureEXT topLevelAS; under an RT compile define (e.g., USE_RT).
Add hasOccluderRT(originWS, dirWS, tMax) using rayQueryInitializeEXT/ProceedEXT; terminate on first hit; opaque flag.

Compute shadowVis=1.0; if (USE_RT && dens>0.01 && (shadeStride%4u==0u)) evaluate hasOccluderRT(pos, lightDir, 200.0) and multiply emission by shadowVis. Add a runtime toggle via push constants or a uniform to disable RT quickly.

acceptance: Visible occlusion under the proxy when RT on; toggling off restores baseline
